token_doc.--sym-ink: fill for ALWAYS-solid elements (arrowheads, dots); resolves to the stroke color
token_doc.--sym-fill: fill for closed shapes: 'none' in hollow styles, stroke color in the Solid family
token_doc.--sym-bg: knockout/halo color (white); halos AND shapes that must hide what is behind them
token_doc.--sym-lw: primary line weight, in viewBox units

drafted.label: Drafted
drafted.note: Thin, crisp, hand-drafted feel. Mitered corners, butt caps.

weighted.label: Weighted
weighted.note: Middle weight, rounded ends. Reads well on a busy plan.

modern.label: Modern
modern.note: Heavy rounded strokes; reads at very small print sizes.

standard.label: Standard
standard.note: Baseline. Hollow closed shapes, no halo.

bold.label: Bold
bold.note: All three line weights multiplied by 1.55.

solid.label: Solid
solid.note: --sym-fill resolves to the stroke color; closed shapes fill in.

symbols.name: Riser
symbols.notes: The conventional quartered-circle riser: opposing quadrants filled, drawn with --sym-ink so the fill survives every style family. Solid is disabled because flooding the circle erases the quadrant pattern.
symbols.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <g fill="none" stroke="var(--sym-stroke)" stroke-width="var(--sym-lw)"
     stroke-linecap="var(--sym-cap)" stroke-linejoin="var(--sym-join)">
    <!-- stroke="none" keeps each wedge an exact 90 degrees: stroking them would
         fatten the black quadrants and pinch the white ones (badly at Bold). -->
    <path d="M50 50 L79.7 20.3 A42 42 0 0 1 79.7 79.7 Z" fill="var(--sym-ink)" stroke="none"/>
    <path d="M50 50 L20.3 20.3 A42 42 0 0 0 20.3 79.7 Z" fill="var(--sym-ink)" stroke="none"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="42" stroke-width="var(--sym-lw-heavy)"/>
  </g>
</svg>
